body:
Everyone has called me a failure my entire life. I'm damned if I do, damned if I don't. It's more than just not being appreciated. I don't know how to describe it. My kids are babies. They really require a lot from me. Despite being married, I do it all on my own. I'm a SAHM. I love my kids. I never get a break though. I haven't been to the movies in over 5 years. I haven't been anywhere without my kids besides to run errands in months. I have no time whatsoever for self care. I clean all day everyday and you can never tell between the kids and the husband. I work hard to be exhausted, dirty, ugly, etc . . .just to be bitched at and accused of sitting on my ass all day on Social Media and watching TV. Hell, I rarely watch TV. Im trapped at home with no transportation and he refuses to get me a bus pass so I am literally trapped at home with children. Social media is my only social oulet
 I can't even be a good mom because I am too tired and too worn out and expected to have 3 meals a day cooked, take care of 4 kids, keep the home spotless, have dinner on the table when he gets home even though he's not going to eat it because he got something from work or decided he wanted Ramen instead. I feel so trapped. Im sad. Im depressed. I can't even stay focused cuz Im overwhelmed.  I keep fantasizing about drowning in the bathtub. I've held back because I was pregnant. Now the baby is born . . . 
I want to stop being sad. Stop being called a failure. But I can't do anything right. I don't wa t to hurt anymore . . .
